title: 1896. Minimum Cost to Change the Final Value of Expression

examples.explanation: We can turn "1&(0|1)" into "1&(0&1)" by changing the '|' to a '&' using 1 operation. The new expression evaluates to 0.
We can turn "(0&0)&(0&0&0)" into "(0|1)|(0&0&0)" using 3 operations. The new expression evaluates to 1.
We can turn "(0|(1|0&1))" into "(0|(0|0&1))" using 1 operation. The new expression evaluates to 0.
